title: National Emergency Medical Ambulance Service (108)
summary: 24x7 emergency medical response service operated across Indian states for critical medical emergencies, trauma, cardiac crises, and urgent hospital transport.
provider: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare & State Health Societies
source: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Govt. of India

title: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK) Transport (102)
summary: Free transport service for pregnant women for delivery and post-delivery care, and for sick neonates up to one year of age to and from public health facilities.
source: National Health Mission, Govt. of India

title: Tele-MANAS (National Tele Mental Health Programme)
summary: Government of India 24x7 comprehensive mental health helpline providing free, confidential counseling and psychiatric tele-consultation in multiple regional languages.
provider: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare & NIMHANS

title: National & State Health Information Helpline (104)
summary: Free 24x7 medical advice helpline offering validation of health queries, minor ailment counseling, directory of nearby blood banks, and public hospital availability.
provider: State Health Societies & National Health Mission
location: Available across Indian States and UTs

title: National Public Health & Disease Helpline (1075)
summary: National toll-free helpline by the Ministry of Health for verified public health information, infectious disease advisories, vaccination schedules, and pandemic inquiries.
provider: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
source: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Govt. of India

title: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) - Emergency & OPD
summary: Premier central government tertiary hospital providing 24x7 emergency medical services, trauma care, advanced super-specialty consultations, and subsidized inpatient care.
provider: AIIMS New Delhi, autonomous institution under MoHFW
location: Sri Aurobindo Marg, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi 110029

title: Vardhman Mahavir Medical College & Safdarjung Hospital
summary: One of India's largest central government multi-specialty hospitals with dedicated 24x7 Emergency, Level-1 Trauma Centre, and multi-disciplinary inpatient departments.
provider: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
location: Ring Road, opposite AIIMS, New Delhi 110029

title: Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia (RML) Hospital
summary: Central government tertiary care hospital featuring round-the-clock emergency casualty, cardiology, neurology, pediatrics, and specialized outpatient clinics.
provider: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
location: Baba Kharak Singh Marg, Connaught Place, New Delhi 110001

title: Ayushman Arogya Mandir (Health and Wellness Centres)
summary: Nationwide network of grassroots primary healthcare centres providing comprehensive primary health care, free essential medicines, diagnostic tests, and maternal-child health services.
location: Grassroots primary health network across urban and rural India

title: Dehydration and Acute Diarrhea: Oral Rehydration Guidelines
summary: Guidelines on managing fluid loss from acute diarrhea and vomiting using WHO-standard Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS) and zinc supplementation. Emphasizes clean drinking water, continued feeding, and red-flag danger signs requiring urgent hospital evaluation.
provider: World Health Organization & Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
source: WHO Diarrhoeal Disease Fact Sheet & MoHFW Standard Treatment Workflows

title: Dengue Fever: Critical Warning Signs and Supportive Care
summary: Clinical awareness guidance for dengue fever. Highlights the critical phase between day 3 to 7: severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, mucosal bleeding, lethargy, and fluid retention. Never take aspirin or ibuprofen; use paracetamol strictly under medical guidance.
provider: National Centre for Vector Borne Diseases Control (NCVBDC)
source: NCVBDC National Guidelines on Clinical Management of Dengue Fever

title: Antenatal Care Essentials and Danger Signs in Pregnancy
summary: Key milestones for pregnant mothers: minimum 4 antenatal checkups, tetanus toxoid vaccination, iron-folic acid supplementation, and balanced nutrition. Critical danger signs include severe headache with blurred vision, vaginal bleeding, high fever, or reduced fetal movement.

title: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: Screening, Symptoms & Lifestyle Care
summary: Educational guidance on early signs of diabetes (frequent urination, excessive thirst, unexplained weight loss, slow wound healing). Recommends regular fasting and HbA1c screening, physical activity, dietary fiber, and routine foot and kidney surveillance.
provider: ICMR - National Institute of Nutrition & NP-NCD
source: ICMR Guidelines for Management of Type 2 Diabetes

title: Hypertension Awareness: Blood Pressure Control & Heart Health
summary: Clear guidance on understanding blood pressure readings (>140/90 mmHg), reducing sodium intake, avoiding tobacco, engaging in regular brisk walking, and recognizing hypertensive crises (severe headache, chest discomfort, shortness of breath).
source: India Hypertension Control Initiative Technical Report

title: Anemia Prevention and Iron Nutrition for Women & Adolescents
summary: Recognizing fatigue, pallor, weakness, and shortness of breath associated with iron-deficiency anemia. Explains iron-rich foods (green leafy vegetables, legumes, jaggery), vitamin C for absorption, and national Iron and Folic Acid (IFA) supplementation.

title: Heat Exhaustion and Heatstroke: First Aid and Prevention
summary: Distinguishing heat exhaustion (heavy sweating, dizziness, rapid pulse) from medical emergency heatstroke (body temperature >104°F, hot red dry skin, confusion, loss of consciousness). Immediate first aid: move to shade, apply cool wet cloths, fan the patient, and seek urgent medical help.
source: NCDC National Action Plan on Heat Related Illnesses

title: Tuberculosis (TB): Recognizing Symptoms and Free Care via Ni-kshay
summary: Recognizing persistent cough for more than 2 weeks, low-grade evening fever, night sweats, chest pain, and unexplained weight loss. Highlights free sputum diagnosis, free anti-TB treatment under the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP), and Ni-kshay nutritional support.
provider: Central TB Division, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
